/admin.html:
Open Teaching Workspace: exams, classes, question imports and announcements

Staff Administration

Manage staff names, assigned subjects and upload permissions.

Classroom toolsApprovals, recovery and backupsQuestion bankStudents

Assign or reset a password

Choose a student or staff account and assign a new password. Existing sessions will be signed out. Passwords are never included in reports.

Change administrator password

Student and staff registration reports

Download registration details as PDF, Word or Excel. Passwords are excluded.

Add a staff account

Staff sign in with these credentials. Only the administrator can create staff accounts.

Staff list

Assigned staff can upload only to their paper and subject. The two original staff accounts retain their existing topic access until you assign a subject here.

Loading staff accounts…

Daily exam marks and analysis

Select the day students submitted their exam. Repeat attempts are listed separately. Reports use 2 marks per correct answer.
/classroom.html:
Classroom Tools

DashboardRevision and support

Assigned revision

Your teacher's practice assignments show instant feedback. Complete them by the due date; late submissions are marked late.

Your private mistake notebook

Save questions from practice or released exam reviews, then write what you learned. Your notes are visible only to you.

Class performance dashboard

Assign targeted revision

Build an exam across topics

Choose up to ten distinct topics and at most 100 questions in total. Each question carries 2 marks. Staff can use only their assigned subjects.

Question history and restore

Every edit, approval, archive and restore records the previous question. Administrators can restore an earlier version; existing attempts keep their original questions.

Check duplicate questions

Imports and new questions also warn about exact matches and similar wording. Similar questions may be intentional; review them before confirming.

Administrator two-factor authentication

Pair your own authenticator app using the manual setup key. Keep the one-use recovery codes privately. Activating or disabling this protection signs out all your sessions.

Use time-based codes, SHA-1, 6 digits, and a 30-second period. Enter a code below to finish setup within ten minutes.

Sign in again

Question submissions and approval

New staff questions and edits need administrator approval. An edited question keeps its current approved version until approval.

Student question reports

Question quality analysis

Shows answer accuracy across up to 5,000 recent scored attempts, including practice. Small samples may not indicate a question problem.

Extra exam time

Set this before the student starts. Extra minutes extend their personal timer, up to the exam's closing time. Set a sufficiently long submission window when scheduling.

Account recovery requests

Verify identity through your school records or in person before resetting a password. Share the new password privately. Request messages are supplied by the requester.

Encrypted backup and restore

Download accounts, questions, exams, attempts, results and settings in a password-protected backup. Sessions and two-factor setup keys are excluded. Existing two-factor protection stays in place during restore. Keep the backup and its passphrase safe; the passphrase cannot be recovered.

Restore an earlier backup

Restore replaces all portal data with the selected backup. Download a fresh backup first. Your current administrator password is retained, and everyone will need to sign in again.
